findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Set.lean:308 `Equiv.Set.sumCompl`, :321 `sumCompl_symm_apply_of_mem`, :325 `sumCompl_symm_apply_of_notMem`; mathlib/Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Sum.lean:261 `Equiv.sumCompl`; mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Sum/Basic.lean:218 `Function.Injective.sumMap`. `Equiv.ofInjective` and `Equiv.subtypeEquivRight` are already used at LabeledGraph.lean:103,107.
findings.fix: Introduce `labelSplit (G : LabeledGraph k) : Fin k ⊕ G.Unlabeled ≃ Fin G.n` as `((Equiv.ofInjective G.label G.label_injective).sumCongr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun a => by simp [eq_comm])).trans (Equiv.Set.sumCompl (Set.range G.label))`, then `glueLeft G₁ G₂ := Sum.map id Sum.inl ∘ (G₁.labelSplit).symm` and `glueRight G₁ G₂ := Sum.map id Sum.inr ∘ (G₂.labelSplit).symm`. Injectivity is then `(Function.Injective.sumMap injective_id Sum.inl_injective).comp (Equiv.injective _)`, `glueLeft_label`/`glueLeft_of_unlabeled` are `Equiv.Set.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_mem`/`_of_notMem`, and `card_unlabeled` is `Fintype.card_congr G.labelSplit` with `Fintype.card_sum`.
findings.issue: `glueLeft`/`glueRight` are assembled from a raw `dite` + `Exists.choose`, forcing hand-proved plumbing: `glueLeft_injective` (155-171), `glueRight_injective` (173-189), `glueLeft_eq_glueRight_iff` (191-212) and `card_unlabeled` (100-107) are all case bashes over that `dite`. Mathlib's combinators do the assembly.

findings.evidence: LabeledGraph.lean:402-403 `glueSwap := (Equiv.refl (Fin k)).sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm _ _)`; LabeledGraph.lean:417-425 `glueSwap_glueRight` already proves `G₁.glueSwap G₂ (G₁.glueRight G₂ b) = G₂.glueLeft G₁ b`, i.e. exactly this identification, entirely by `rfl` after rewriting with the left lemmas.
findings.fix: Move `glueSwap` above `glueRight` and define `glueRight G₁ G₂ b := G₂.glueSwap G₁ (G₂.glueLeft G₁ b)`. Then `glueRight_label` and `glueRight_of_unlabeled` are `congrArg _ (glueLeft_label ..)`/`(glueLeft_of_unlabeled ..)` followed by `rfl` on `Sum` (`glueSwap` computes by `rfl` on both summands, as the current 411/414/422/425 `rfl`s show), `glueRight_injective` is `(G₂.glueSwap G₁).injective.comp (glueLeft_injective ..)`, and `glueSwap_glueRight` is the `Equiv.symm_apply_apply`-style cancellation of the two swaps.
findings.issue: The whole right-hand family duplicates the left one line for line with `Sum.inl`/`Sum.inr` swapped: `glueRight` (125-127) vs `glueLeft` (120-122), `glueRight_label` (137-143) vs `glueLeft_label` (129-135), `glueRight_of_unlabeled` (150-153) vs (145-148), `glueRight_injective` (173-189) vs `glueLeft_injective` (155-171), and `glueSwap_glueRight` (416-425) vs `glueSwap_glueLeft` (405-414). The file's own `glueSwap` (402-403) makes the right family definitionally the left one of the swapped pair.

findings.evidence: LabeledGraph.lean:452-455 `glueCommEquiv_glueInr : G₁.glueCommEquiv G₂ (G₁.glueInr G₂ b) = G₂.glueInl G₁ b`; LabeledGraph.lean:471-476 `glueCommIso` gives `map_rel_iff'`; the statement of `glue_adj_inr` at 312-315 is `glue_adj_inl G₂ G₁` with the arguments swapped.
findings.fix: Move `glueCommIso`/`glueCommEquiv_glueInr` above these lemmas and prove `glue_adj_inr G₁ G₂ a b` as `((glueCommIso G₁ G₂).map_adj_iff).symm.trans (by rw [glueCommEquiv_glueInr, glueCommEquiv_glueInr]; exact glue_adj_inl G₂ G₁ a b)`; likewise derive `glue_adj_inr_of_unlabeled` from `glue_adj_inl_of_unlabeled G₂ G₁`. `glueCommIso` depends only on `glue_graph`, `map_sup` and the `glueSwap` lemmas, not on the adjacency eliminators, so reordering is free.
findings.issue: `glue_adj_inr` (312-327) re-proves `glue_adj_inl` (294-309) from scratch in mirrored form, and `glue_adj_inr_of_unlabeled` (370-374) mirrors `glue_adj_inl_of_unlabeled` (363-367). Both statements are exactly the left-hand ones transported along the commutativity isomorphism proved later in the same file.

summary: Layer 8a is new material and the matrix side reuses Mathlib well, but the gluing carrier plumbing re-derives by hand what `Equiv.ofInjective`/`Equiv.sumCompl` supply, and the entire right-hand family (`glueRight*`, `glue_adj_inr*`) is a verbatim mirror of the left one that the file's own `glueSwap`/`glueCommIso` already makes derivable.
